proposals: The US Department of Energy’s Loan Programs Office should publish, for each loan guarantee, the amount committed, drawn to date and the date of each drawdown, so that capital events such as Montana Renewables’ $1.44 billion guarantee and $782 million first drawdown can be tracked from the lender’s own record, not press releases.

The California Air Resources Board should publish monthly renewable-diesel and sustainable-aviation-fuel output by facility from Low Carbon Fuel Standard reporting, so that a refinery such as Paramount going months without producing SAF shows up in official data before it shows up as a restructuring.

The Department of Food and Public Distribution should publish a distillery-wise register of India’s ethanol capacity, owner group and commissioning date, so that ownership consolidation such as Triveni Engineering’s 61.77% stake in Sir Shadi Lal Enterprises can be read against the roughly ₹40,000 crore of distillery investment.

The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas should publish oil marketing companies’ ethanol allocations by supplier group for each ethanol supply year, so that whether India’s capacity build-out is concentrating in a few owners can be checked from procurement data rather than inferred from occasional stake purchases.
